hero.description: View of the antechamber, west wall, scene 3. Represented in the upper register: Atum between two lions, the Benu bird, the mummy (of Nefertari) on a bed between two falcons which represent the goddesses Nephthys and Isis. These are representations connected with the central register, which presents Spell 17 of the Book of the Dead. Below, represented on the left is a decoration composed of Djed pillars and Tit knots, while in the centre there is a cavetto cornice, with representations of sanctuaries. The presence of wall fragments on the shelf and debris on the floor could suggest that the photograph was taken shortly after the discovery of the tomb.
